top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A childs hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: In the 3 to 5 yr old classroom the room had inadequte light and the children were not visable. The caregiver could not see the children.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.
